The '''opee sea killer''', sometimes referred to as simply an '''opee''', was a large carnivorous sea creature of approximately twenty meters (66 feet) in length. A hybrid of crustacean and fish, it inhabited the watery [[Planet/Legends|planet]] core of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. It was the third-largest predator on Naboo, smaller than only the [[Colo claw fish/Legends|colo claw fish]] and the even larger [[Sando aqua monster/Legends|sando aqua monster]], which both preyed on it. It was the largest creature on the planet to have a prehensile tongue. Another of its predators was the [[titavian]].<ref name="WSWFG" />

==Characteristics==
[[File:OpeeSeaKiller-PM.png|thumb|left|280px|Opee profile view]]
The opee sea killer is an amalgam of evolutionary traits found in other animals. It has armor and limbs like a [[Crustacean/Legends|crustacean]], but has the massive hinged jaws of other [[Fish/Legends|fishes]].<ref name=":1" /> The opee was a predator that often clung to rocky outcroppings or hid in caverns or under ledges awaiting prey.<ref name=":0" /> When forced to move, the opee was perfectly adapted to swim–in its own unusual way–sucking water into its mouth and propelling it from pores beneath armored plates at the rear of its body. This unique technique, coupled with three pairs of powerful legs and a pair of pectoral guidance fins, allowed the opee to accelerate quickly underwater.<ref name=":1" /> Once in range of prey, the opee would extend its massive, gooey, purple prehensile tongue, successfully catching its prey,<ref name=":0" /> and reeling it into a vicious, gaping maw of multi-rowed teeth.<ref name=":1" /> If its prey was small, the opee would simply use its prehensile tongue to pull it into its mouth and quickly devour it in one bite. If prey were large, then after grabbing it, the opee would bite several times before eating it whole. The opee also used the long antennas protruding from the top of its head as lures to draw prey towards its double rows of fangs.<ref name="WSWFG" /> Its thick chitinous hide could deflect blasts from energy blasters.

Opees were known to be mouth breeders, with the male opee carrying fertilized eggs inside its mouth for three months–forcing the male to fast until the young were born. From birth, opees could sustain themselves instinctively (and gruesomely). It was not unknown for unhatched opee eggs to be swallowed by [[Colo claw fish/Legends|colo claw fish]], creatures later killed in a grisly manner when the newborn young chewed their way out of the colo's stomach. This could also occur if the colo swallowed young opees alive.<ref name="WSWFG">''[[The Wildlife of Star Wars: A Field Guide]]''</ref>

==History==
[[File:Opee_attack.png|thumb|250px|An opee uses its purple prehensile tongue to eat its prey.]]
During the time of the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], an opee sea killer spotted the [[Tribubble bongo/Legends|tribubble bongo]] used by [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]], and [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] (who referred to it as a "big gooberfish") to reach the city of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]]. It stealthily pursued the submersible, and caught up quickly. Mere inches away, the opee extended its purple prehensile tongue, grabbing it and jerking it into its mouth. As it was attempting to feast, the creature was attacked by an even larger underwater predator–the massive [[Sando aqua monster/Legends|sando aqua monster]], considered the opee's deep-sea rival. The monster bit down on the fish, causing it to release its prey, before tearing it in half and devouring it.<ref name=":0" />

During the early [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] roughly 30 years later, an opee sea killer spotted a bongo vehicle that was traveling around the ocean floor. It fired its purple prehensile tongue at the sub and pulled it into its mouth, but it was quickly devoured by a sando aqua monster before it had a chance to eat it, which a [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]]–owned [[StarSpeeder 1000]] witnessed.<ref name="STAC">''[[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue]]''</ref>

By unknown means, opees were introduced to [[Aquilaris]], and could be seen swimming by the tunnels in which [[Podracing/Legends|podraces]] took place.<ref name="Star Wars: Episode I Racer">[[Star Wars: Episode I Racer|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''Racer'']]</ref>

One opee sea killer was housed inside the [[Royal Icqui Aquaria]], a large, public aquarium that was situated on the planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], and the sea killer was the largest living creature in the facility.<ref name="Coruscant and the Core Worlds">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref>

{{Creature-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Early designs of the opee sea killer showed a creature that was little more than a tooth-filled jaw grafted onto a combination [[Wikipedia:fish|fish]] and [[Wikipedia:crab|crab]] body. Later sketches refined the look, though a possible design direction incorporating mammalian characteristics–a long body and a fin-like tail–were explored and abandoned. The opee stayed the fish/crab hybrid, and the mammal traits were worked into the sando aqua monster designs.<ref name=":1">{{DB|creature|opeeseakiller|opee sea killer}}</ref>

The digital model for the Opee sea killer was built by [[Derek Gillingham]] at [[Industrial Light & Magic]].<ref name="Derek-Reel">{{WebCite|url=https://vimeo.com/938779619|text=Derek Gillingham Show Reel|author=Derek Gillingham|date=2024-04-24|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/nSmUs}}</ref>

In the first draft of the {{Film|I}} script, the opee sea killer was to attack the bongo with "paralyzing spit balls," but they were replaced with a purple prehensile tongue.<ref name="Secret History">{{WebCite|url=http://fd.noneinc.com/secrethistoryofstarwarscom/secrethistoryofstarwars.com/index.html|text=The Beginning - A Look at the Rough Draft of Episode I|work=The Secret History of Star Wars|archivedate=20201109001328}}</ref>
